name: Roasted tomato soup
blurb: Like a warm hug in a bowl, with bread for dunking.

name: Cheesy garlic bread
blurb: Nobody has ever said no to this. We checked.

name: Prawn cocktail
blurb: A retro classic, back by popular demand since 1975.

name: Seared scallops, pea purée & bacon
blurb: Ninety seconds a side and not one second more.

name: Sticky chicken bites
blurb: Bring napkins. Then bring more napkins.

name: Tomato bruschetta
blurb: Sunshine on toast, best when tomatoes are in season.

name: Salmon fishcakes
blurb: Golden, crispy and suspiciously easy to eat three of.

name: Chicken & leek gyoza
blurb: Hand-pleated dumplings. Each one gets a little pep talk.

name: Asparagus & hollandaise
blurb: Only here for six weeks a year, like a very green celebrity.

name: Halloumi fries
blurb: Squeaky cheese, but make it chips.

name: Loaded potato skins
blurb: Crispy boats of cheese and bacon, sailing straight to you.

name: Fish & chips with mushy peas
blurb: The national treasure. Salt, vinegar and a wedge of lemon.

name: Bangers & mash
blurb: Proper sausages, buttery mash and a lake of onion gravy.

name: Sirloin steak frites
blurb: Cooked exactly how you like it. Chips exactly how everyone likes them.

name: Cheeseburger & fries
blurb: Two hands required. Possibly three.

name: Crispy chicken burger
blurb: Crunchy outside, juicy inside, a bun that holds it all together.

name: Mushroom & halloumi burger
blurb: A veggie burger so good the meat-eaters keep asking for a bite.

name: Margherita pizza
blurb: Tomato, mozzarella, basil. Simple, perfect, gone in minutes.

name: Bacon & mushroom pizza
blurb: The pizza that started a hundred friendly arguments about toppings.

name: Spaghetti bolognese
blurb: Slow-simmered sauce and a snowfall of parmesan.

name: Spaghetti carbonara
blurb: No cream, just eggs, cheese and confidence.

name: Wild mushroom risotto
blurb: Stirred with patience and a little bit of love.

name: Seafood linguine
blurb: A trip to the Italian seaside, no passport needed.

name: Chicken tikka masala
blurb: Often voted Britain's favourite dish. It knows, and it's very humble about it.

name: Thai green curry
blurb: Fragrant, zingy and just warm enough to make you smile.

name: Chicken katsu curry
blurb: Crunchy chicken, silky curry sauce, a mountain of rice.

name: Prawn & veggie noodle stir-fry
blurb: Sizzling, speedy and full of crunch.

name: Pork belly ramen
blurb: The broth takes twelve hours. Slurping is encouraged.

name: Roast chicken dinner
blurb: Roast potatoes, a Yorkshire pudding and gravy. Every day is Sunday here.

name: Shepherd's pie
blurb: Cosy lamb under a fluffy, golden potato duvet.

name: Steak & ale pie
blurb: Flaky pastry, rich gravy, and a lid you'll want to lift slowly.

name: Slow-cooked lamb shoulder
blurb: Cooked so slowly it falls apart if you look at it kindly.

name: Duck breast, red wine jus
blurb: Crispy skin, blushing pink middle, glossy sauce. Chef is very proud.

name: Pan-roasted salmon, crushed potatoes
blurb: Crispy skin, buttery potatoes and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Moules frites
blurb: A big pot of mussels and a bowl for the empty shells. Very satisfying.

name: Chicken Caesar salad
blurb: Crunchy, cheesy and secretly quite filling.

name: All-day full English
blurb: Breakfast, but you can have it at teatime. We won't tell.

name: Jacket potato, cheese & beans
blurb: Fluffy inside, crispy outside, cheese melting everywhere.

name: Mac & cheese
blurb: Bubbling, golden and extremely cheesy. As it should be.

name: Ploughman's lunch
blurb: Cheese, bread, pickles and an apple. A picnic on a plate.

name: Cornish-style pasty
blurb: Crimped by hand. The crust was invented as a handle, you know.

name: Little chef's fish fingers
blurb: Kids' plate: crunchy fish fingers, chips and peas. Ketchup on request.

name: Tiny tomato pasta
blurb: Kids' plate: little pasta shapes, tomato sauce, a cheesy top.

name: Chunky chips
blurb: Triple-cooked and fluffy in the middle.

name: House salad
blurb: Crisp leaves and a zippy dressing. Yes, it counts as one of your five a day.

name: Beer-battered onion rings
blurb: Golden hoops. Perfect for wearing as rings before eating.

name: Buttered peas & leeks
blurb: Green, glossy, and much tastier than your vegetables at home.

name: Sourdough & salted butter
blurb: Warm bread and proper butter. Dangerously moreish.

name: Cheesy chips
blurb: Chips wearing a cheese blanket. Comfort level: maximum.

name: Sticky toffee pudding
blurb: Warm sponge, toffee sauce, and a strong chance of seconds.

name: Eton mess
blurb: A pudding that's supposed to look like it fell over. Very relaxing.

name: Apple crumble & custard
blurb: Crunchy on top, jammy underneath, custard all over.

name: Chocolate brownie & ice cream
blurb: Gooey in the middle, crackly on top, cold ice cream on the side.

name: Tiramisu
blurb: Its name means 'pick me up'. It's very good at its job.

name: Crème brûlée
blurb: Tap tap tap... crack! The most satisfying sound in the restaurant.

name: Knickerbocker glory
blurb: A tall glass of ice cream with a very long spoon.

name: British cheese board
blurb: Three cheeses, crackers and chutney. For people who think cheese is pudding.

name: Flat white
blurb: Velvety milk, double shot, tiny heart drawn on top.

name: Pot of tea
blurb: Milk in first or second? We're staying out of it.

name: Hot chocolate
blurb: Topped with cream and a sprinkle of happiness.

name: Homemade lemonade
blurb: Squeezed this morning, so sharp it winks at you.

name: Cola or lemonade
blurb: Fizzy, cold and comes with a straw.

name: Pressed apple juice
blurb: From an orchard down the road. The apples are very proud.

name: Strawberry milkshake
blurb: Thick enough to stand a straw up in.

name: Glass of house wine
blurb: Red or white, friendly and fuss-free. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of good red
blurb: Picked by someone who uses the word 'tannins'. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of prosecco
blurb: Bubbles for celebrating, or for Tuesday. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Pint of lager
blurb: Cold, crisp and poured with a proper head. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Pint of local ale
blurb: Brewed three streets away by a man with a magnificent beard. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Gin & tonic
blurb: Ice, a slice, and a satisfying fizz. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Espresso martini
blurb: Shaken hard until it's frothy on top. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Classic Stacker
blurb: One patty, one slice, one squirt of secret sauce. Exactly the same in every town.

name: Double Stacker
blurb: Twice the patty, twice the cheese, twice the napkins.

name: Crispy Chicken Bun
blurb: Crunchy on the outside, juicy in the middle, gone in a minute.

name: Garden Stacker
blurb: A spiced veggie patty for the no-meat crowd. Nobody misses out.

name: Fish Fillet Bun
blurb: Crumbed white fish, a half slice of cheese and a dab of tangy sauce.

name: Nugget Box (6)
blurb: Six golden nuggets and two dips. Arguments about which dip is best are free.

name: Crispy Chicken Wrap
blurb: Rolled up tight so it survives the walk back to the office.

name: Garden Wrap
blurb: The veggie patty, wrapped up with crunchy lettuce and sauce.

name: Sunrise Egg Muffin
blurb: A round egg on a toasted muffin. Breakfast, sorted, before the bus comes.

name: Sausage & Egg Muffin
blurb: The early-bird favourite. Tastes better if you're still a bit sleepy.

name: Bacon Breakfast Muffin
blurb: Crispy bacon, a soft egg and a squiggle of sauce.

name: Little Nugget Meal
blurb: Four nuggets, small fries, apple slices and a little toy. The box is the best bit.

name: Little Stacker Meal
blurb: A mini burger, small fries, apple slices and a toy surprise.

name: Skinny Fries
blurb: Hot, salty and gone before you sit down.

name: Big Fries
blurb: For sharing. Or not sharing. We won't tell.

name: Cheesy Fries
blurb: Fries under a melty blanket of cheese.

name: Hash Brown
blurb: A golden potato rectangle. Crunch level: excellent.

name: Swirl Cone
blurb: A tall swirl in a crunchy cone. Eat fast on hot days.

name: Gooey Chocolate Cookie
blurb: Warm from the oven with chocolate puddles in the middle.

name: Vanilla Thick Shake
blurb: So thick the straw stands up on its own.

name: Chocolate Thick Shake
blurb: Chocolatey, cold and very hard to share.

name: Strawberry Thick Shake
blurb: Pink, sweet and brain-freeze cold.

name: Fizzy Fountain Drink
blurb: Pick a flavour and press the button. Refills not included.

name: Counter Coffee
blurb: Hot, quick and in a cup with a lid. Business people love it.

name: Warm cheese gougères
blurb: Tiny, puffy cheese clouds that vanish in one bite.

name: Quail egg, truffle & toast soldier
blurb: A dippy egg the size of a marble, with a wisp of winter truffle.

name: Chilled pea & mint shot
blurb: Bright green, very cold and gone in one sip.

name: Wye Valley asparagus, morels & wild garlic
blurb: Six spears picked yesterday. Spring on a plate, for about six weeks a year.

name: Hand-dived scallop, blood orange & hazelnut
blurb: One perfect scallop, sweet and nutty, with a sharp little burst of orange.

name: Scottish langoustine, brown butter & girolles
blurb: Sweet langoustine tails with golden mushrooms and nutty butter.

name: Heritage beetroot, aged cheese & hazelnut
blurb: Beetroots in every colour of a sunset, roasted, pickled and raw.

name: Roast turbot, mussels & sea herbs
blurb: The king of flat fish, roasted on the bone and basted until glossy.

name: Native lobster, garden peas & lemon butter
blurb: Half a lobster, butter-poached, with peas that pop.

name: Langoustine raviolo, shellfish bisque
blurb: One big silky parcel in a sauce that took all afternoon.

name: Salt-baked cod, truffle & leek
blurb: Pearly white cod under a snowfall of winter truffle.

name: Wild venison, beetroot & bitter chocolate
blurb: Deep, dark and wintry. The chocolate is a secret; don't tell.

name: Aged beef fillet, truffle & potato terrine
blurb: A hundred thin layers of potato, a perfect pink fillet and black truffle.

name: Aged beef fillet, girolles & bone marrow sauce
blurb: A perfect pink fillet with golden late-summer mushrooms.

name: Spring lamb, wild garlic & morels
blurb: Lamb with a green wild-garlic crust, from the first warm weeks of the year.

name: Aged duck, forced rhubarb & turnip
blurb: Rhubarb grown in the dark, pink as a flamingo, cuts through the rich duck.

name: Passion fruit & yuzu sorbet
blurb: A tiny, zingy scoop to wake up your taste buds before pudding.

name: Forced rhubarb & vanilla custard
blurb: Rhubarb and custard, like the sweets, but grown up and very pink.

name: Single-origin chocolate, hazelnut & sea salt
blurb: Chocolate from a single farm, as smooth as a pebble from the beach.

name: Vanilla soufflé, blood orange
blurb: It rises, it wobbles, it must be eaten now. Everybody hold your breath.

name: Garden strawberries, vanilla & tiny tart
blurb: Strawberries picked this morning on the thinnest, crispest pastry.

name: Mountain cheese trolley
blurb: Wheeled to the table with a little speech about each cheese.

name: Glass of Downs sparkling
blurb: Tiny bubbles from chalky hills, for celebrating. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of Loire white
blurb: Crisp and zesty, best friends with fish. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of Alsace Riesling
blurb: Smells like apples and flowers; sings next to spicy things. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of white Burgundy
blurb: Rich and buttery, made for lobster. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of Provence rosé
blurb: Pale pink and sunny. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of Rioja reserva
blurb: Warm and spicy, aged in oak barrels for years. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Glass of red Burgundy
blurb: Light, silky and fussy to grow: the wine expert's favourite. (Grown-ups only.)

name: Small glass of Sauternes
blurb: Golden and honey-sweet, for pudding. (Grown-ups only.)
